name: Say
subtitle: Calm speech practice for kids
promotional_text: A calm, ad-free speech-practice app: see a card, hear the word, say it, celebrate. Made for children practising their first words.
description:
Say is a calm speech-practice app for children. Pick a category, see one big friendly card, hear its word, and say it back — a correct word triggers a joyful celebration and the next card appears by itself.

There is never a wrong-buzzer, a red cross or a score. If a word isn't heard, Say simply listens again, replays the word, and keeps Skip within reach — no child ever gets stuck.

- Three starter categories: Animals, Food and Vehicles
- Every card is editable: what is shown, what is said, and which words count as correct
- Parents can add their own cards, hide cards and reorder them per language
- Speech recognition runs on the device where supported; recordings are never stored or uploaded
- Works in multiple languages and follows your Tiko language setting
- Child mode keeps the screen focused and distraction-free

Say is part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused communication and learning tools.
release_notes:
Welcome to Tiko Say 1.0 — calm speech practice for kids.

• Six picture categories: Animals, Food, Vehicles, Body, Colors and Numbers
• Hear each word in a friendly voice, say it back, and celebrate the win
• Every card is editable: what is shown, what is said, and which words count
• Add your own cards with pictures from the Tiko media library
• Speaks and listens in English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German and Maltese
• No ads, no scores, no pressure — a missed word simply gets a gentle retry
